descriptions.zh: 根据 PRD、产品目标、用户流程或现有应用上下文设计并实现产品 UI，覆盖响应式、可访问性、视觉方向与渲染验证。
descriptions.en: Design and implement product UI from product context with responsive behavior, accessibility, visual direction, and rendered verification.

applicable_domain: product UI design and implementation for existing applications
standalone responsive frontend screens, landing pages, dashboards, and component sets
negative_examples: write a complete PRD or discover an undefined product direction
perform backend-only implementation or broad repository maintenance
produce visual analysis without a requested UI design or implementation outcome
prerequisites: a product goal, user flow, design request, or existing UI context is available
the requested screen or interaction scope is specific enough to design or implement
